forWhat: From the menu, this opens Assessments showing only what waits for approval.
A class's week opens its own page: each child's paper, the level it is set at and why. Change any child, then approve the pack.

layout.shows: [[Approve … papers and … spares]], or [[Nothing left to approve]].
What everyone is working on, and how many children are at each level.
Roll, Child, Level, Why, Paper with [[See the paper]], Status, and [[Change level]].
A link on to Assessments, to print and give.

jobs.title: Approve a class's papers
steps: Open the class's week, for example from [[Approve class papers]] on Home assessments.
Read each child's level and why. Press [[See the paper]] to look at one.
Press [[Approve … papers and … spares]]. The pack is marked printed.

jobs.title: Change one child's level
steps: Open [[Change level]] on the child's row.
Choose the new level and write why. A change with no reason is refused.
Press [[Change this child]]. The child keeps this level until you change it again.

buttons.label: Approve … papers and … spares
buttons.does: Approves the class's papers and spares not yet approved, in your name, and marks the pack printed.
buttons.doesNot: It counts only papers not approved before.

buttons.label: Change level
buttons.does: Opens the choice of a new level and a reason for one child.

buttons.label: Change this child
buttons.does: Sets that child's level and records who changed it and why.
